title: What will the U.S. President's RealClearPolitics approval rating be this week?
settlement: Each weekly event is a ladder of narrow percentage-band markets. It resolves on a snapshot of the approval number displayed on RealClearPolitics's Trump approval-rating aggregate page (realclearpolling.com/polls/approval/donald-trump/approval-rating) at 11:00 AM ET on the strike date.
